#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <stdexcept>

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int first = std::cin.get();
    if (first == EOF) {
        throw std::runtime_error("NullPointerException equivalent");
    }
    if (first == '\n' || first == '\r') {
        std::cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    int previous = first;
    int runLength = 1;
    int result = 0;
    
    while (true) {
        int c = std::cin.get();
        if (c == EOF || c == '\n' || c == '\r') {
            if ((runLength & 1) == 0) {
                result++;
            }
            break;
        }
        if (c == previous) {
            runLength++;
        } else {
            if ((runLength & 1) == 0) {
                result++;
            }
            previous = c;
            runLength = 1;
        }
    }
    std::cout << result << '\n';
    return 0;
}
